replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
Hello,

Unfortunately, we cannot punish players for team spleefing for just showing us that message.
This is because it could have been a mistake, and we might unfairly punish a player.
If you can gather sufficient evidence (preferably in video format), feel free to submit another report.

Regards,
MLGPorky, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
